md_docs_2closed-pr-review-audit-2026-11-06 - Closed pull request review audit — 2026-11-06

Scope: pull requests closed from 2026-08-06 through 2026-11-06 in this repository. The inventory contains 132 closed PRs, 587 review threads, and 205 threads still marked unresolved. Each row below links to the first comment in one such thread. A GitHub thread being unresolved does not establish that the reported defect is still present.

The PR includes fixes for live findings; other entries were checked against the current code or GitHub code-scanning state. The original closed-PR threads remain unchanged while this draft is reviewed.

Hosted MCP URL rendering is not an SSRF sandbox. Its existing deployment guidance requires external egress controls for private, loopback, link-local and metadata networks, including redirects and nested media requests. Operators must enforce those controls; the application does not do so.

The Windows mirror lazy-audio integration passes after waiting for the resized sync inventory to render. The error-popup screenshot smoke test and error-journal contract also pass with a platform-appropriate backtrace assertion.

Review-body findings

  • #460 rainbow output and #489 key-byte logging: fixed in this PR.
  • #530 encrypted packet CRC: addressed in the earlier audit.
  • #526 host packet accounting: the earlier follow-up removed the duplicate count and recorded it in the same audit.
  • #529 keyboard cleanup: the input worker initializes the keyboard after thread creation succeeds, so a thread-creation failure does not initialize or destroy the keyboard shared with the required sync screen.
  • #564 update cache: path joining is already corrected; helper probing was moved before presentation and its cache made atomic in this PR. The formatting report was checked against current formatting.
  • #565 log selection and highlighting: current log rendering retains the selected position by sequence and highlights matching text.
  • #567 early telemetry options: fixed in this PR by using the option registry during early mode detection.
  • #578 TOML mode validation and non-PCH header: already present in current code. Its hosted URL and bind-address review is addressed by the existing explicit network-isolation requirement and the bind validation in this PR; the application does not itself enforce that egress policy.
  • #581 word deletion: current editor uses an ASCII-only whitespace predicate.

Nitpicks in review bodies

  • #448 regex fallback: the fallback probe now runs on all platforms using the explicit JIT-disable setting.
  • #459 discovery callback: current code copies the error fields under the mutex.
  • #473 video restoration: the integration predicate now requires a dense, multicolored video frame. The full Windows integration script passes with a terminal tall enough for the help screen.
  • #474 decoded-frame copy: retained the padded, aligned FFmpeg conversion buffer and compact row copy. Direct writes would need separately validated slot capacity and FFmpeg alignment across frame widths.
